name.en-US: Grace: Commentary on the Theological Summa of St. Thomas, Ia IIae, q. 109-114
name.pt-BR: A graça: comentário à Suma teológica I-II, qq. 109-114

description.en-US: Commentary on the Summa theologiae I-II, qq. 109-114: the necessity of grace, its essence, its causes, justification and merit, with the long excursus on sufficient and efficacious grace. Translation by the Dominican Nuns of Corpus Christi Monastery, Menlo Park, of De gratia (1946-47), Herder 1952.
description.pt-BR: Comentário à Suma teológica I-II, qq. 109-114: a necessidade da graça, sua essência, suas causas, a justificação e o mérito, com o longo excurso sobre a graça suficiente e eficaz. Tradução inglesa das monjas dominicanas de Corpus Christi, Menlo Park (Herder, 1952) de De gratia (1946-47).

en-US.translator: Dominican Nuns of Corpus Christi Monastery, Menlo Park

sources.edition: Grace: Commentary on the Theological Summa of St. Thomas, Ia IIae, q. 109-114, Dominican Nuns of Corpus Christi Monastery, Menlo Park, St. Louis: B. Herder, 1952 (archive.org Lagrange-English); the Latin original is imported separately where available
